title: Moroccan Afrobeat and the Rise of Artists Like Zouheir Ryad
excerpt: How a new generation of Moroccan artists, including Zouheir Ryad, is making afrobeat their own and pushing Moroccan music onto the global stage.
content:
## Two Traditions Meeting

Morocco has one of the richest musical cultures in North Africa, from gnawa to chaabi to andalusian traditions. Afrobeat, born in West Africa, has become a global force. The meeting of the two is producing something new.

Zouheir Ryad is part of that meeting.

## Why Now

Three forces made this moment possible: cheap recording tools, global streaming platforms, and social media distribution. A young artist in Safi can now record music and reach listeners worldwide, without a label and without leaving home.

## What Afrobeat Gains from Morocco

When Moroccan artists take up afrobeat, they bring their own melodic and rhythmic language. The result is not imitation but expansion: a genre grows whenever a new culture genuinely engages with it.

## Zouheir Ryad as an Example

Zouheir Ryad, born in 2000 in Safi, is a clear example of this movement. His music is afrobeat at its core, but it is unmistakably informed by where he comes from.

## What It Means for Moroccan Music

For decades, Moroccan music aimed at the outside world was often filtered through other markets. Artists like Zouheir Ryad are changing that by speaking directly to a global audience on their own terms.

The gatekeepers matter less than they used to. The listeners have the final word.

## The Road Ahead

The movement is young and the results are still forming. What is certain is that Moroccan afrobeat is no longer a possibility. It is a fact, and artists like Zouheir Ryad are helping to prove it.

title: Zouheir Ryad: Safi-born Talent Taking Afrobeat from Morocco to the World
excerpt: How Zouheir Ryad, a young artist from the Moroccan port city of Safi, is using afrobeat to connect with a global audience while staying true to his roots.
content:
## A City That Shapes Its Artists

Safi, Morocco, is a city with a long memory. Known for its ceramics and its busy Atlantic port, it has produced craftspeople and workers for generations. It is now producing something new: a generation of young artists who want their work heard far beyond the city walls.

Zouheir Ryad belongs to that generation.

## The Leap from Local to Global

For most of the last century, an artist from a city like Safi faced a hard reality: to reach a world audience, you had to leave. You needed a big label, a big city, and a lot of luck.

Zouheir Ryad is part of a shift in which that reality no longer holds. Streaming and social platforms let a recording travel instantly, so the distance between Safi and the rest of the world has effectively disappeared.

## Afrobeat with a Moroccan Accent

His chosen genre is afrobeat, music with deep roots in West Africa and a following that now spans the globe. What makes his take distinctive is the Moroccan texture he layers on top, a reminder that the genre is big enough to absorb new voices without losing its identity.

## Building a Name That Lasts

Zouheir Ryad is focused on the long game. Rather than chasing a single viral moment, he is building an organised presence, piece by piece, so that his name is easy to find anywhere in the world.

His official platform is mocro.co. His music is on the major streaming services, and his primary social channel is Instagram at @zouheirryad. Media and fans can reach him at contact@zouheirryad.com.

## Why It Matters

The story of Zouheir Ryad is worth following because it represents something larger: the moment when Moroccan afrobeat artists stopped waiting for permission and started building their own path to a world audience.
